The research, theoretical development, and writing were conducted independently through Future State, LLC, as part of an ongoing program of independent scholarship. The author received no honoraria, speaker fees, or other compensation related to the subject matter of this paper during the period of its preparation.

detail.abstract:
The major couples therapy modalities — Gottman Method Couples Therapy, Emotionally Focused Therapy, Integrative Behavioral Couples Therapy, and their cognitive-behavioral variants — share a foundational assumption that relational distress is primarily communicational: that the couple is not hearing each other, is caught in negative interaction cycles, and has accumulated unresolved grievances that have calcified into positions. The intervention is therefore structured around improving the quality of the exchange: listening skills, de-escalation of the four horsemen, repair of past hurts through structured dialogue. This paper argues that this assumption is correct for one population and systematically wrong for another — and that the second population may represent a substantial proportion of couples presenting for treatment.

The paper draws on Barrett's Theory of Constructed Emotion, the Fear Response Gap framework (Anderson, 2021–2026), the Singularity Stack construct (Anderson, 2026), and the Haa Latseení relational transmission theory (Anderson, 2026) to specify four conditions under which the grievance that brings a couple to counseling is not the cause of their relational distress. It is the predictive model's construction of an explanation for a body budget signal whose actual source is architecturally prior to the relationship: intimate layer granularity deficit, dopamine habituation misread as abandonment, outer Dunbar architecture depletion producing relational overload, and the Singularity Stack configuration in which the relationship is carrying the entire body budget restoration load that the intimate layer's natural distributed architecture was designed to bear.

The swapping and switching mechanisms specify why grievance-resolution interventions produce temporary relief followed by recurrence: the grievance is suppressed without addressing the process generating it, and the process generates a new grievance from the same substrate. The paper develops the intervention architecture the framework implies — a specific resequencing of couples counseling that addresses body budget substrate before grievance content, delivers dopamine habituation psychoeducation before the first grievance exchange, audits outer Dunbar architecture before dyadic communication training, and builds individual granularity capacity before asking either partner to communicate what they do not yet have the vocabulary to construct.

Seven falsifiable propositions are developed. The paper concludes with a proposal for a resequenced couples counseling protocol — the Substrate-First Protocol — whose design follows directly from the framework's architectural analysis and whose predicted outcomes are specified in the propositions. The paper is the applied companion to the Singularity Stack theoretical paper (Anderson, 2026) and the couples counseling application of the framework that Suicide Is Not the Problem (Anderson, 2026) applies to the suicide prevention field: the same architectural move, the same structural critique, a different presenting complaint.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了主流夫妻疗法的核心假设——即关系困扰本质上是沟通问题。作者提出，对于相当一部分夫妻， grievances（ grievances）并非关系痛苦的真正原因，而是身体预算信号（body budget signal）被预测模型错误解释的结果。论文基于构建情绪理论、恐惧反应差距框架、奇点堆栈等理论，提出了"基质优先协议"（Substrate-First Protocol），主张在解决 grievance 内容之前，先处理身体预算基质、多巴胺习惯化、外层邓巴架构和个体粒度能力等前置问题。
AI.research_question: 对于相当一部分寻求治疗的夫妻，导致他们前来咨询的 grievance 是否并非关系痛苦的真正原因？如果是，那么真正的根源是什么，以及应当如何重新设计干预方案？
AI.motivation: 主流夫妻疗法（Gottman疗法、情绪聚焦疗法、整合行为夫妻疗法等）普遍假设关系困扰主要是沟通问题，但临床实践中常出现症状反复的现象，暗示这一假设可能对某些人群系统性地不适用。作者试图识别这一被忽视的人群，并提出基于身体预算和神经架构的治疗新路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: Barrett的构建情绪理论（Theory of Constructed Emotion）；恐惧反应差距框架（Fear Response Gap Framework, Anderson 2021–2026）；奇点堆栈构念（Singularity Stack, Anderson 2026）；Haa Latseení关系传递理论（Anderson 2026）
AI.method: 理论构建论文，通过整合多学科理论框架（情绪科学、神经生物学、关系人类学）提出新的夫妻治疗干预架构，并给出七个可证伪命题。
AI.findings: 提出了四种情况下 grievance 不是关系痛苦的真实原因：亲密层粒度缺陷、多巴胺习惯化被误读为被抛弃、外层邓巴架构枯竭导致关系过载、奇点堆栈配置中关系承担了本应由分布式架构承载的全部身体预算修复负荷。提出了"置换与切换机制"（swapping and switching mechanisms）解释为何 grievance 解决干预只能产生暂时缓解。提出了"基质优先协议"（Substrate-First Protocol）作为重新排序的夫妻咨询方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 将构建情绪理论和身体预算模型系统性地引入夫妻治疗领域；提出了关系困扰的"基质优先"解释框架，挑战了沟通中心主义的治疗假设；发展了"置换与切换机制"来解释治疗复发的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一套具体的重新排序的夫妻咨询协议（Substrate-First Protocol），包括：在处理 grievance 内容之前先处理身体预算基质、在第一次 grievance 交换之前进行多巴胺习惯化心理教育、在夫妻沟通训练之前审计外层邓巴架构、在要求伴侣沟通之前建立个体粒度能力。给出了七个可证伪命题，为后续实证检验提供了明确方向。

title: Harvesting Factor Premia Across Regimes: An Anchor-Stabilized Hidden Markov Framework for Multifactor Portfolios
affiliations: NYU Stern School of Business

detail.title: Harvesting Factor Premia Across Regimes: An Anchor-Stabilized Hidden Markov Framework for Multifactor Portfolios
detail.abstract:
Two influential industry studies provide complementary benchmarks for dynamic factor allocation. Ilmanen et al. (2021) of AQR show that traditional factor-timing strategies often deliver limited out-of-sample gains, while Botte and Bao (2021) of Two Sigma show that latent market states can be recovered from factor-return panels but do not directly translate regime information into portfolio decisions.
This paper develops a regime-conditioned downside-aware multifactor allocation frame- work that converts latent market states into implementable portfolio weights. Focusing on a U.S. equity investment universe, we extend static Gaussian Mixture Model regime classifica- tion into a Gaussian Hidden Markov Model that captures regime persistence and transition dynamics. One-step-ahead regime probabilities are mapped into factor allocations through turnover-aware mean–variance optimization with Ledoit–Wolf covariance shrinkage. VIX and CAPE are excluded from regime identification and used only as auxiliary optimization anchors, stabilizing the reference allocation without serving as standalone return predictors.
Evaluated under a strict expanding-window walk-forward protocol from 2013–2023, the framework improves downside control and produces smoother return paths, especially during the 2020 COVID shock and the 2022 joint equity–bond drawdown. The S&P 500 achieves a higher annualized return over the same period, but with 15.06% volatility, a Sharpe ratio of 0.90, and a maximum drawdown of -23.97%. In comparison, a long-only protective specification achieves a Sharpe ratio of 1.33 with maximum drawdown of -3.64%, and a long- short specification achieves a Sharpe ratio of 1.24 with maximum drawdown of -5.78%. The results suggest that factor premia remain economically useful when latent regime information is translated into disciplined portfolio decisions.

keywords: P.M. (2026). The Singularity Stack: Intimate Layer Concentration
and the Process Dynamics of Modern Relational Collapse. SSRN Working Paper

detail.abstract:
The Fear Response Gap framework (Anderson, 2021–2026) describes the behavioral stack as organized across three valence categories — positive constructive, positive destructive, and neutral — with each category producing a characteristic DOSE neurochemical profile and circumplex position. The Haa Latseení companion paper (Anderson, 2026) identifies the High-Functioning Dyadic Deficit Profile as the most prevalent presentation of unresolved relational architecture depletion in high-functioning individuals: high outer Dunbar layer functioning coexisting with a depleted intimate layer. The present paper introduces a new construct — the Singularity Stack — that extends the High-Functioning Dyadic Deficit Profile analysis into three specific population expressions that the current clinical literature has failed to theorize adequately.

The Singularity Stack is defined as a stack configuration in which one behavioral position — most commonly the pursuit of intimate connection, or a single existing intimate relationship — generates DOSE output so intensely and so variably that it dominates the process dynamics of the entire stack. The rest of the stack — including substantial positive-constructive load — becomes process noise against the amplitude of the singularity's swings. The control chart signature is distinctive: moderate mean, extreme variability, with all major excursions keyed to the state of a single source.

The paper develops three population expressions of the Singularity Stack. The first is the Lonely Epidemic Population — the person with no current intimate target, whose DOSE architecture has reorganized around the anticipatory dopamine of intimate search, producing high arousal, variable valence, and a body budget sustained entirely by the pursuit of what it most requires. The second is the Infidelity Architecture — the person in a stable long-term relationship who cannot construct the serotonin-dominant state of secure attachment as rewarding because their intimate layer granularity is insufficient to distinguish habituation from abandonment, generating the dopamine-seeking pattern that infidelity reliably delivers and relationship stability cannot. The third is the Performance Occupation — the actor, musician, athlete, and creator whose occupational structure embeds high-frequency rejection into the primary work activity, producing a process where the occupational output itself is structured to generate special-cause signals at unpredictable intervals, interacting catastrophically with intimate layer depletion to produce cumulative allostatic load at multiplicative rather than additive rates.

The paper also examines the implication the Singularity Stack carries for the couples counseling profession — its central argument being that the standard couples counseling architecture, built on the assumption that relational distress is primarily communicational, systematically misreads the Singularity Stack as a grievance to be resolved rather than a body budget substrate problem to be restored. Eight falsifiable propositions are developed. The paper concludes with the intervention architecture the Singularity Stack analysis implies — one that redirects therapeutic attention from the relational surface to the body budget floor, and from the dyadic exchange to the outer Dunbar architecture whose depletion makes the singularity necessary in the first place.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"奇点堆栈"新构念，描述一种行为堆栈配置——单一行为位置（如追求亲密关系或某段亲密关系）产生的DOSE输出强度极大、变异性极高，主导整个堆栈的动态过程。研究识别了三种人群表达：孤独流行病群体、不忠架构群体和表演职业群体，并批判了现有伴侣咨询范式将关系困扰误读为沟通问题而非身体预算基底问题。
AI.research_question: "奇点堆栈"这一新构念如何解释高功能个体中未被现有临床文献充分理论化的三种特定人群表达？以及它对伴侣咨询行业有何启示？
AI.motivation: 现有临床文献未能充分理论化高功能个体中某些特定行为堆栈配置模式，特别是那些单一亲密关系追求或单一关系主导整个行为系统动态的现象。作者试图填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 恐惧反应缺口框架（Fear Response Gap framework, Anderson, 2021–2026）、行为堆栈（Behavioral Stack）、DOSE神经化学特征模型、圆周模型（Circumplex）、高功能二元缺陷剖面（High-Functioning Dyadic Deficit Profile）、身体预算（Body Budget）理论。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念分析，基于已有理论框架（恐惧反应缺口框架、高功能二元缺陷剖面）进行延伸推理，提出八个可证伪命题。
AI.findings: 识别了"奇点堆栈"的三种人群表达：（1）孤独流行病群体——无当前亲密目标，DOSE架构围绕亲密搜索的预期多巴胺重组；（2）不忠架构群体——处于稳定长期关系中但因亲密层粒度不足无法将血清素主导的安全依恋构建为奖赏，转而追求多巴胺驱动的不忠模式；（3）表演职业群体——演员、音乐家、运动员等，其职业结构将高频拒绝嵌入主要工作活动，与亲密层耗竭产生乘数级累积负荷。标准伴侣咨询架构系统性地误读了奇点堆栈问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"奇点堆栈"这一新理论构念，扩展了高功能二元缺陷剖面的分析，将关系困扰的视角从沟通范式转向身体预算基底范式，为理解特定人群的亲密关系困境提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 批判了现有伴侣咨询范式对奇点堆栈的误读，提出了以身体预算基底修复为核心的干预架构——将治疗注意力从关系表面转向身体预算基底，从二元交换转向外邓巴层架构的恢复。

title: Tax Department Workforce Heterogeneity and Tax Planning
affiliations: Vienna University of Economics and Business,  and Paderborn University

detail.title: Tax Department Workforce Heterogeneity and Tax Planning

publicationDetails.detailsText: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series No. 241
publicationDetails.journalName: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study examines whether and how workforce heterogeneity within corporate tax departments shapes firms’ tax planning. Using employee-level data for U.S. firms from 1993 to 2024, we document a substantial increase in heterogeneity over time. In multivariate analyses, we find no robust association between overall tax department heterogeneity and firms’ tax planning. However, this result masks important differences across underlying dimensions of heterogeneity. Specifically, cognitive heterogeneity, capturing variation in education, experience, tenure, and seniority, is positively associated with tax planning, whereas demographic heterogeneity, capturing variation in gender and ethnicity, exhibits a negative association. Additional analyses suggest that cognitively heterogeneous tax departments identify more sophisticated tax planning opportunities, utilize tax-related inputs more effectively, and maintain more stable tax strategies. In contrast, demographic heterogeneity is associated with greater variability in tax outcomes. Overall, these findings highlight a trade-off between the informational benefits and coordination costs of workforce heterogeneity within corporate tax departments.

AI.tldr: 研究发现企业税务部门的整体异质性与税收筹划无显著关联，但认知异质性（教育、经验等）正向促进税收筹划，而人口统计学异质性（性别、种族）则产生负向影响，揭示了信息收益与协调成本之间的权衡。
AI.research_question: 企业税务部门内部劳动力异质性是否以及如何影响企业的税收筹划行为？
AI.motivation: 税务部门对企业的合规与税收筹划至关重要，但部门内部人员的多样化特征（异质性）如何影响税收决策尚不清楚。既有研究多关注高管团队或董事会多样性，较少深入探讨税务部门这一特定职能团队的异质性效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息/决策理论（认知多样性带来更广泛的信息与更创新的问题解决方式）；协调成本理论（人口统计学多样性可能增加沟通障碍与群体冲突，降低决策效率）。
AI.method: 基于1993-2024年美国企业员工层面数据，使用多元回归分析，区分认知异质性（教育、经验、任期、资历）与人口统计学异质性（性别、种族）分别进行检验，并辅以进一步分析验证机制。
AI.findings: 1）税务部门整体异质性与税收筹划无稳健关联；2）认知异质性与税收筹划正相关，可识别更复杂的筹划机会、更有效利用税收输入、维持更稳定的策略；3）人口统计学异质性与税收筹划负相关，且与税收结果更大的波动性相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了税务部门团队构成异质性的双重效应（信息收益 vs. 协调成本），拓展了劳动力多样性与企业财务决策交叉领域的研究，并区分了不同类型异质性的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业组建和优化税务部门团队提供指导：提升认知多样性（教育背景、经验等）有助于改善税收筹划，而单纯追求人口统计学多样性可能带来协调挑战，需配合有效的沟通与整合机制。

title: Heavy Metal Contamination in Lualaba Province (DRC): IoT-Satellite Fusion Monitoring of Cobalt, Lead, and Copper Exposure in Artisanal Mining Communities (2019–2024)
affiliations: Mangosuthu University of Technology and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Heavy Metal Contamination in Lualaba Province (DRC): IoT-Satellite Fusion Monitoring of Cobalt, Lead, and Copper Exposure in Artisanal Mining Communities (2019–2024)
detail.abstract: This study presents a comprehensive five-year investigation (2019–2024) into heavy metal contamination and environmental health impacts in Lualaba Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, a global epicentre of artisanal and small-scale cobalt mining. Integrating innovative Internet of Things (IoT) airborne particulate monitoring with satellite remote sensing, soil sampling, and community health data, the research offers insights into temporal and spatial pollution dynamics. The deployment of a low-cost, modular EnviroSense IoT sensor network enabled continuous, high-resolution monitoring of key pollutants including cobalt, lead, copper, and fine particulate matter demonstrating high operational reliability (94.2% uptime) at a fraction of the cost of traditional regulatory networks. Analysis reveals a significant distance-decay gradient for heavy metal concentrations, with communities within 3 km of ASM operations experiencing PM2.5 levels 3.2 times higher than background areas, and household dust cobalt concentrations averaging 312 mg/kg 156 times the WHO soil guideline. Blood lead levels in children under five in proximity to ASM zones averaged 18.4 μg/dl well above international safety thresholds highlighting urgent public health concerns. The fusion of satellite data (Sentinel-5P TROPOMI, Landsat-8/9, Sentinel-2) with ground measurements validated the spatial extent of pollution sources and facilitated accurate dispersion modeling. The findings underscore a growing environmental and health crisis driven by unregulated artisanal mining, with annual estimates attributing approximately 847 premature deaths and over 2,300 hospitalizations to PM2.5 exposure. The study emphasizes the critical need for policy interventions, including mandatory buffer zones of at least 5 km, community-based environmental monitoring, and targeted health screening programs. The low-cost IoT monitoring framework demonstrated here provides a scalable, replicable model capable of enhancing environmental accountability, empowering communities, and informing evidence-based regulation. Future directions include expanding sensor coverage, integrating real-time health data, fostering regional data-sharing initiatives, and promoting sustainable mining practices to mitigate ongoing environmental degradation and protect vulnerable populations.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过五年（2019-2024）综合调查，利用物联网传感器网络、卫星遥感、土壤采样和社区健康数据，揭示了刚果（金）卢阿拉巴省手工和小规模钴矿开采导致的重金属污染严重程度及公共卫生危机，并提出低成本、可复制的监测框架与政策建议。
AI.research_question: 刚果（金）卢阿拉巴省手工和小规模钴矿开采区重金属污染（钴、铅、铜及细颗粒物）的时空分布特征、环境健康影响及其驱动机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 卢阿拉巴省是全球手工钴矿开采中心，但缺乏长期、高分辨率的环境监测数据，传统监管网络成本高昂，现有研究未能充分揭示污染梯度、健康负担以及社区暴露水平，亟需低成本、可扩展的监测方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 距离衰减梯度理论（污染浓度随距矿源距离增加而下降）、环境暴露-健康效应模型（PM2.5与死亡率和住院率关联）、多源数据融合框架（IoT地面监测+卫星遥感+土壤采样+健康数据）。
AI.method: 部署EnviroSense低功耗物联网传感器网络（94.2%运行率）进行连续污染物监测；结合Sentinel-5P TROPOMI、Landsat-8/9、Sentinel-2卫星遥感数据；采集土壤与家庭粉尘样本；收集社区健康数据（儿童血铅水平）；运用空间分析与分散建模。
AI.findings: （1）污染呈现显著距离衰减梯度，距矿区3公里内PM2.5水平为背景区的3.2倍；（2）家庭粉尘钴浓度均值312 mg/kg，为WHO土壤指导值的156倍；（3）5岁以下儿童血铅水平均值18.4 μg/dl，远超国际安全阈值；（4）估计每年约847例过早死亡和2,300例住院归因于PM2.5暴露。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了在数据匮乏的欠发达矿区，低成本IoT物联网网络与卫星遥感融合可实现高精度时空污染制图，拓展了环境暴露科学在非洲手工采矿情境下的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出至少5公里强制性缓冲区政策建议；提供可复制的低成本监测模型以增强环境问责、赋权社区；倡导扩大传感器覆盖、整合实时健康数据、推动区域数据共享及可持续采矿实践。

title: The Accumulation Tax: A Political-Economy Diagnosis of Irish Government Policy Congestion

detail.title: The Accumulation Tax: A Political-Economy Diagnosis of Irish Government Policy Congestion

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants, animal subjects, or personal data, and therefore did not not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors sectors

detail.abstract: The Irish state operates an institutional architecture under which procedural complexity in public administration is not a failure of culture or individual conduct, but a rational equilibrium produced by the asymmetric payoff structure on procedural addition versus procedural removal under the formal rules of the Civil Service Performance Management and Development System and the Comptroller and Auditor General audit framework. Adding an approval layer is costless to the adder — the delay it generates falls on citizens and downstream officials — and is rewarded by political cover and audit-trail accumulation. Removing an approval layer is costly to the remover, personally exposure if anything subsequently fails, and is not rewarded by any assessed outcome in the existing performance framework. The collective outcome is policy congestion of an estimated 1.45 to 2.15 billion euros of annual waste, four-to-six-week processing times against international comparator minutes, and seventeen to twenty-five hours weekly per civil servant consumed by procedural overhead. The paper diagnoses the mechanism, traces it across four sources (multiple approval layers, jurisdictional overlap, outdated process requirements, lack of decision authority), examines four international comparators (Estonia, Singapore, Denmark, Netherlands), each deploying a Specific architectural primitive against one source, and proposes a five-pillar reform framework (Decision Authority Matrix, Jurisdictional Clarity Framework, Digital Process Automation, Process Simplification, Performance Accountability) that engages the asymmetric-payoff structure at the rule-set level. The reform programme operates jointly with the three-instrument programme proposed in the Departmental Confrontation and the Coordination Failure (Conneely, 2026) through three intersecting reforms: the principal whose payoff function is aligned with the outcome, the individual reward function under the CSPMDS, and the Programme Accountability Ledger as cross-pathology supporting architecture. The two papers together constitute a complete diagnosis of the Irish public administration's asymmetric-payoff structure and a coherent reform architecture calibrated to alter it on both the cross-sectional and longitudinal axes.

AI.tldr: 本文诊断爱尔兰公共行政中程序复杂性的根源：在现行公务员绩效管理与审计框架下，增加审批层级对官员无成本且有收益（政治掩护、审计痕迹），而减少层级则有个人风险且无奖励，导致系统性的政策拥堵与效率损失（年浪费14.5-21.5亿欧元）。论文提出五支柱改革框架，从规则层面修正这种不对称收益结构。
AI.research_question: 爱尔兰公共行政中程序复杂性的根本原因是什么？如何从制度设计层面解释并解决这一问题？
AI.motivation: 爱尔兰公共服务存在严重的程序复杂性（政策拥堵），导致巨大经济浪费和效率低下。现有解释常归因于文化或个人行为，但本文主张这是制度规则下理性均衡的结果，需要从机制设计角度进行诊断与改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不对称收益结构理论：在公务员绩效管理与审计框架下，"增加审批层级"对官员零成本且有收益（政治保护、审计痕迹积累），而"移除审批层级"对官员有个人风险且无奖励，由此产生的理性均衡导致系统性的程序膨胀。
AI.method: 机制诊断分析（追踪四个来源：多重审批层级、管辖权重叠、过时流程要求、缺乏决策权限）；国际比较分析（爱沙尼亚、新加坡、丹麦、荷兰四个案例，各国针对某一来源部署特定架构原语）；改革框架设计。
AI.findings: 程序复杂性是制度规则下理性均衡的产物，而非文化或个人失败；估计年度浪费14.5-21.5亿欧元；处理时间长达4-6周（国际对比为分钟级）；每位公务员每周17-25小时用于程序性开销。
AI.theory_contributions: 将公共行政的程序复杂性问题重新定义为制度层面的"不对称收益结构"导致的理性均衡，而非个体或文化问题，为官僚冗余提供了新的理论解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出五支柱改革框架（决策权限矩阵、管辖权清晰框架、数字流程自动化、流程简化、绩效问责），在规则层面修正不对称收益结构；与Conneely (2026)的三工具方案协同，构成完整的诊断与改革体系。

title: How Fast Does AI Actually Work? Per-Task Speedup Measurement Across a Validated Sample of O*NET Anchors
affiliations: and Liminal Capital

detail.title: How Fast Does AI Actually Work? Per-Task Speedup Measurement Across a Validated Sample of O*NET Anchors
detail.abstract: Existing estimates of AI-induced productivity gains span an order of magnitude. Random- ized controlled trials (RCTs) report speedups of 1.3–2.2× on contained professional tasks. The Anthropic Economic Index (AEI), based on conversation telemetry, reports a median of approximately 9× across the O*NET task universe. We propose a hybrid measurement that pairs AEI’s directly observed with-AI conversation time with externally measured human- only baselines from time-motion studies, RCTs, and government productivity benchmarks. Across a final sample of 25 anchors, the C∗-weighted BEA value-added economy speedup is 3.09× (95 percent CI [2.40, 4.27]), robust across alternative aggregations (range 2.91–3.49×). The method avoids reliance on AEI’s annotation-derived without-AI estimate, whose bias is unknown, while extending the RCT literature to a broader task population. Anchor selection uses bidirectional search and independent blind audits of task ambiguity and source-AEI unit alignment; sources are independently verified and anchors with documented unit mismatches are dropped. The paper makes four contributions. First, the headline 3.09× is a measure- ment of economy-wide AI productivity that does not rely on AEI’s without-AI estimate. Second, it provides an independent estimate of the per-task speedup parameter s used in economy-wide productivity frameworks; current calibrations anchored to observed deployment gains (Verschuere and Cameron 2026, s = 1.38) are materially below the anchor-based estimate, suggesting downstream productivity projections may be conservative. Third, we observe that the speedup gradient by C∗ visible in AEI’s universe medians is not reproduced in our anchor sample; whether this reflects sample composition, AEI artifact, or a genuinely smaller gradient than theory predicts cannot be settled with 25 anchors and warrants further work. Fourth, the anchor method provides a framework for validating AEI’s reported per-task speedups, yielding class-specific bias factors of 0.28–0.85 at the universe level and 0.44–0.58 controlling for task selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合测量方法，结合AI对话时间与外部人工基线，估算出美国经济整体AI生产力提升约为3.09倍（95%置信区间[2.40, 4.27]），并对比了现有RCT和AEI的估计差异。
AI.research_question: 如何更准确地测量AI对经济整体生产力提升的影响？现有RCT和AEI的估计差异为何如此之大？
AI.motivation: 现有AI生产力提升估计跨度极大（RCT报告1.3–2.2倍，AEI报告中位数约9倍），亟需一种更可靠的混合测量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 锚定混合测量法：将AEI直接观测的AI对话时间与外部人工基线（时间动作研究、RCT、政府生产率基准）配对，避免依赖AEI的推测性无AI估计。
AI.method: 基于25个锚点样本，采用双向搜索和独立盲审确保任务对齐，使用C*加权及BEA增加值权重进行经济整体推算。
AI.findings: (1) 经济整体AI速度提升为3.09倍（95% CI [2.40, 4.27]）；(2) 现有校准参数s=1.38被低估；(3) AEI中C*的速度提升梯度在锚点样本中未复现；(4) 锚点方法可提供AEI偏差因子（0.28–0.85）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出不依赖AEI无AI估计的经济整体AI生产力测量方法；独立估计了每任务速度提升参数s，显示现有校准可能保守。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供更可靠的经济层面AI生产力估计；为验证和校准AEI等大规模测量工具提供框架。

title: Mental Health and the Economics of Education in Colombia: Fiscal, Institutional, and Equity Implications of Law 2460 of 2025
affiliations: Universidad de las Américas y El Caribe UNAC and University of the Americas and the Caribbean – CLIIC

detail.title: Mental Health and the Economics of Education in Colombia: Fiscal, Institutional, and Equity Implications of Law 2460 of 2025
detail.abstract:
This article analyzes the interaction between Law 2460 of 2025, which reforms Law 1616 of 2013 on mental health, and the economics of education in Colombia. In order to understand how the new legislation impacts the education system, an examination of its repercussions in the pedagogical, budgetary and fiscal sustainability has been carried out through three complementary analytical exercises. To give empirical support to this assessment, the study is supported by the emotional education workshop of the 'Flexible Educational Model Pensar', aimed at teachers and implemented with the endorsement of the Departmental Education Secretariat of Quindío in the municipalities of La Tebaida, Montenegro and Calarcá.

At first glance, the results show great progress. The law commits schools to integrate emotional education and mental health care into their day-to-day lives, not as just another option. But when the Law is put into practice, a question arises that the law leaves unanswered: where does the money come from to pay for it? In the absence of funding, what in theory is progress becomes a burden that many institutions feel unable to take care of.

This is not to deny the value of integrating mental health into the formal curriculum. This in itself constitutes an important structural change. The problem is that a well-intentioned law can remain on paper if it does not consider the differences that exist between a school in Bogotá and one located in a remote municipality of the country. Economic and institutional capacity is not the same everywhere, and this territorial inequality is, perhaps, the Achilles' heel of all regulation.

To give an overview of these tensions and to deal with the problem from different angles, the analysis resorts to several theoretical frameworks. On the one hand, it is based on the theory of human capital, which ranges from the foundational studies of Schultz (1961) and Becker (1964) to what Heckman (2006) contributed. On the other hand, there is the economics of educational externalities along the lines of McMahon (2009). And to all this is added the impact evaluation models of Levin and McEwan (2001). It is this amalgam of perspectives that allows us to arrive at a rigorous diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了哥伦比亚第2460号心理健康法改革对教育体系的影响，发现虽然法律要求学校将情感教育和心理健康纳入日常教学，但缺乏明确资金来源和地区差异考量，导致政策落地困难。
AI.research_question: 哥伦比亚第2460号法律（2025年）对教育体系的心理健康改革产生了怎样的影响？在法律要求学校整合情感教育与心理健康关怀的背景下，资金来源和地区差异如何影响政策实施效果？
AI.motivation: 法律要求学校将心理健康教育融入日常教学，但未明确经费来源，且忽视地区间经济与制度能力的巨大差异，导致政策可能流于形式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论（Schultz, 1961；Becker, 1964；Heckman, 2006）、教育外部性经济学（McMahon, 2009）、影响评估模型（Levin & McEwan, 2001）。
AI.method: 三项互补性分析：1）教育学影响分析；2）预算分析；3）财政可持续性分析。实证部分依托"灵活教育模式Pensar"情感教育工作坊，在基恩迪奥省三个城市实施。
AI.findings: 法律在理论上取得重大进步，要求学校将情感教育和心理健康关怀纳入日常教学；但实践中缺乏明确资金来源，使本应成为进步的政策在资源不足的学校中变成难以承受的负担；波哥大与偏远地区的学校之间存在显著的经济和制度能力差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 将人力资本理论、教育外部性理论与心理健康政策分析相结合，构建了评估心理健康立法对教育系统影响的综合分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示哥伦比亚心理健康教育改革中的资金缺口和地区不平等问题，为政策制定者提供预算和财政可持续性方面的实证依据，提示政策制定需考虑不同地区的异质性。

title: Prompt Injection Attacks Against Clinical LLM Agents Accessing Electronic Health Records: A Survey, Threat Model, Benchmark Specification, and Layered Defense Synthesis
affiliations: OWOW Talents Inc, , OWOW Talents Inc and Cisco Systems

detail.title: Prompt Injection Attacks Against Clinical LLM Agents Accessing Electronic Health Records: A Survey, Threat Model, Benchmark Specification, and Layered Defense Synthesis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: D. Pandey and G. Pathak are co-founders of OWOW Talents Inc. S. Manchanda is a graduate student at San Francisco Bay University. N. Sonkar is an independent researcher. The authors declare no other competing interests. None of the authors' affiliated organizations had a role in the conception, design, drafting, or decision to submit this work, and the views expressed are those of the authors alone and do not necessarily represent the views of any affiliated organization. No human subjects, identifiable patient data, or institutional EHR systems were involved; the paper presents a survey, threat model, benchmark specification, and defense synthesis only. Anthropic's Claude was used during manuscript preparation as an editorial aid for structural review, copy-editing, and citation verification; the authors reviewed and verified all citations, technical claims, and conclusions, and responsibility for any errors rests with the authors alone.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This work is a survey, threat model, benchmark specification, and defense synthesis. It involved no human subjects, no animal subjects, no identifiable patient data, and no institutional electronic health record systems; therefore no ethics approval or participant consent was required.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no external funding for this work.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study is not a clinical trial; no clinical trial registration is required.

detail.abstract: Clinical large language model (LLM) agents are entering production hospital deployments, where they read longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs), retrieve evidence from clinical knowledge bases, and assist with summarization, dosing, triage, and guideline-based decisions. The same architectural patterns that make these agents useful-instruction-following on retrieved text, tool use over patient data, and multi-turn conversation-also expose them to prompt injection attacks across heterogeneous input channels. This paper makes four contributions: (i) a structured survey of prompt injection in medical LLMs, including the MPIB benchmark, the JAMA Network Open simulation study, oncology vision-language attacks, and the broader prompt-injection literature; (ii) a threat model for EHR-accessing agents organized around five injection channels, four attacker objectives, and three cross-tenant risks, with explicit mapping to defense layers; (iii) EHR-Agent-PI, a benchmark specification extending MPIB and BIPIA along agentic, cross-channel, and outcome-aware dimensions, with specified scenarios, attack rules, disambiguated evaluation metrics (ASR, CHER, PER, TMR, FPR-H), per-cell instance counts, a reference judge prompt, a synthetic-data schema, a documented cost model, and a responsible-release plan compatible with HIPAA and GDPR constraints; and (iv) a layered six-layer defense architecture for clinical deployments, with explicit layerinteraction analysis. Empirical instantiation of EHR-Agent-PI is described as planned future work, with a small-scale pilot outlined in Section 8.5.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了面向临床大语言模型（LLM）代理的提示注入攻击问题，提出了一个包含威胁模型、基准测试规范（EHR-Agent-PI）和六层防御架构的综合框架，旨在提升医院部署中电子健康记录（EHR）访问代理的安全性。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地识别、评估和防御临床LLM代理（尤其是访问电子健康记录的代理）面临的提示注入攻击风险？
AI.motivation: 临床LLM代理已进入实际医院部署，但其架构模式（指令遵循、工具使用、多轮对话）使其易受跨异构输入通道的提示注入攻击，而现有研究对此缺乏系统性威胁建模和防御方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 威胁建模框架（五条注入通道、四种攻击者目标、三种跨租户风险）；六层防御架构（含层间交互分析）。
AI.method: 结构化调研+威胁建模+基准规范设计（EHR-Agent-PI，扩展自MPIB和BIPIA）+防御架构设计+小规模试点（未来工作计划）。
AI.findings: 识别了临床LLM代理的五条提示注入通道、四种攻击者目标和三种跨租户风险；提出了EHR-Agent-PI基准规范（含场景、攻击规则、评估指标（ASR, CHER, PER, TMR, FPR-H）、参考法官提示、合成数据模式、成本模型和负责任的发布计划）；设计了六层防御架构及层间交互分析。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次针对临床EHR访问代理构建了系统化提示注入威胁模型，明确了攻击通道-目标-风险的映射关系，并提出了专门的基准规范和防御架构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医院部署临床LLM代理提供了可操作的威胁分类、标准化评估基准（EHR-Agent-PI）和分层防御架构，有助于提升实际临床环境中AI系统的安全性与合规性（HIPAA/GDPR）。

title: Energy Becomes Flow Through Gradient: Physical Evidence That Gradient Collapse Precedes Flow Breakdown, with 690-Month Verification
affiliations: and

detail.title: Energy Becomes Flow Through Gradient: Physical Evidence That Gradient Collapse Precedes Flow Breakdown, with 690-Month Verification

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The corresponding author is the principal developer of the gradient-based flow diagnostic framework presented in this paper. The authors declare no competing financial or institutional interests beyond the intellectual ownership of the framework described herein. No external funding was received in connection with this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involves no human or animal subjects. The research is based on theoretical physical principles (Onsager 1931, Poiseuille's law) and publicly available macroeconomic time-series data from official sources (Bank of Korea ECOS, Federal Reserve Economic Data). No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was conducted without external funding.

detail.abstract: In all flow systems, flux is a function of gradient (Onsager, 1931 [2]). When the gradient vanishes, flow cannot exist. This thermodynamic principle applies to every system in which a mediator flows through a tube network-from blood vessels to financial pathways. Existing early-warning systems, however, depend solely on the absolute value of flow, and therefore detect collapse only after the gradient has already died. Scheffer et al. [1] discovered statistical early-warning signals (critical slowing down) near critical transitions, but did not provide a physical explanation for why these signals appear. This paper addresses that unresolved question. The gradient is the existence condition of flow (Onsager, 1931 [2]). When the gradient vanishes, flow cannot exist. Therefore, gradient collapse is not a signal correlated with flow breakdown-it is the necessary antecedent stage of flow breakdown. The critical slowing down observed by Scheffer is the statistical shadow of this gradient collapse. This paper formalizes the principle explicitly and verifies its precedence empirically using 690 months of economic time-series data. In the verification, gradient indicators led absolute-value indicators by an average of six months in three endogenous crises (the Korean IMF crisis of 1997, the Korean Card Crisis of 2003, and the Global Financial Crisis of 2008). For an exogenous shock (COVID-19, 2020), the lead time was zero months, in agreement with theoretical prediction. These results suggest that gradient collapse is not a mere statistical phenomenon but a physically grounded, scalable principle governing flow breakdown.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Onsager热力学原理，提出流量系统的崩溃并非由流量绝对值下降引起，而是由梯度（驱动流量的势差）消失所致。梯度塌缩是流量崩溃的必要先导阶段，Scheffer等人发现的临界减缓现象实际上是梯度塌缩的统计影子。作者用690个月的经济时间序列数据验证了这一原理，发现梯度指标比绝对值指标平均早6个月预警三次内生性危机，而对COVID-19这类外生冲击则无提前预警，符合理论预期。
AI.research_question: 流量系统崩溃的物理机制是什么？为什么现有早期预警系统（依赖流量绝对值）无法提前检测到崩溃？Scheffer等人发现的临界减缓现象背后的物理解释是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有早期预警系统仅依赖流量绝对值，只能在梯度已经消失、崩溃已然发生后才能检测到。Scheffer等人发现了临界减缓的统计信号，但未能提供物理解释。本文旨在从Onsager热力学原理出发，揭示梯度塌缩作为流量崩溃必要先导阶段的物理机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: Onsager热力学原理（1931）：在所有流动系统中，流量是梯度的函数；梯度消失则流量不复存在。梯度是流量的存在条件，梯度塌缩是流量崩溃的必要先导阶段。临界减缓（critical slowing down）是梯度塌缩的统计影子。
AI.method: 理论形式化推导+实证验证。使用690个月的经济时间序列数据，比较梯度指标与绝对值指标在三次内生性危机（1997年韩国IMF危机、2003年韩国卡债危机、2008年全球金融危机）和一次外生冲击（2020年COVID-19）中的预警提前时间。
AI.findings: 在三场内生性危机中，梯度指标比绝对值指标平均提前6个月发出预警信号；对于外生冲击（COVID-19），预警提前时间为零个月，与理论预测一致。表明梯度塌缩不是纯粹的统计现象，而是具有物理基础的、可扩展的流量崩溃原理。
AI.theory_contributions: 为Scheffer等人发现的临界减缓现象提供了物理机制解释——临界减缓是梯度塌缩的统计影子。将Onsager热力学原理从物理系统拓展到经济金融系统，建立了流量崩溃的统一物理理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融和经济系统的早期预警提供了新的方法论——梯度指标比传统绝对值指标能更早发现危机信号，平均提前6个月。同时也指出该方法对外生冲击无效，有助于区分内生性危机与外生冲击。

title: Testing Times: Reputation for Debt Discipline
affiliations: University of Toronto - Department of Economics

detail.title: Testing Times: Reputation for Debt Discipline
detail.abstract: How do countries build a reputation for debt discipline? I develop a continuoustime model in which an impatient government, whose income follows a jumpdiffusion process, finances consumption by issuing long-term debt to patient investors. The opportunistic government cannot commit to future debt policies and builds reputation by mimicking a commitment type that maintains a stable debtto-income ratio. I characterize a Markov perfect equilibrium in closed form. Reputation building is necessarily slow and confined to "testing times," episodes of large negative shocks during which debt reduction becomes a credible signal of commitment. Reputation building is path-dependent and risky: a single large shock builds reputation faster than a sequence of smaller ones, yet it also raises the risk of reputation loss. Because reputation is built through disciplined debt management rather than timely repayment, its loss need not trigger immediate default; instead, it shifts bondholders' expectations about future debt policy, generating divergent paths for countries that maintain reputation and those that lose it. With positive reputation, debt prices decouple from current debt ratios and are driven primarily by the history of past "tests." Without reputation, bondholders anticipate continuous issuance and dilution, so debt prices become sensitive to-and decreasing in-current debt ratios.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个连续时间模型，研究政府如何通过债务管理建立信誉。信誉建立必然缓慢，且局限于"考验期"——即大规模负冲击期间，债务削减成为可信的承诺信号。信誉具有路径依赖性和风险性：单次大冲击比多次小冲击更快建立信誉，但也增加了信誉丧失的风险。有信誉时，债务价格与当前债务比率脱钩；无信誉时，债务价格对当前债务比率敏感且递减。
AI.research_question: 国家如何建立债务纪律的信誉？
AI.motivation: 解释为什么主权债务市场中信誉建立是缓慢的、路径依赖的，以及为什么国家在面对负面冲击时会出现不同的债务动态路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间博弈论模型、马尔可夫完美均衡、信誉机制设计（基于模仿承诺型政府行为）
AI.method: 连续时间动态模型，分析一个不耐烦的政府（收入服从跳跃扩散过程）向耐心投资者发行长期债务，通过模仿承诺型政府（维持稳定的债务收入比）来建立信誉。
AI.findings: （1）信誉建立必然缓慢，且局限于"考验期"（大规模负冲击时期）；（2）信誉建立是路径依赖且危险的：单次大冲击比多次小冲击更快建立信誉，但也增加信誉丧失风险；（3）信誉通过纪律性债务管理而非及时偿还建立，因此信誉丧失不立即引发违约，而是改变债券持有人的预期；（4）有信誉时，债务价格与当前债务比率脱钩；无信誉时，债务价格对当前债务比率敏感且递减。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信誉建立机制引入主权债务模型，揭示了信誉建立的"考验期"特征和路径依赖性，解释了为什么信誉建立是缓慢和危险的，以及为什么不同国家在面临类似冲击时会出现债务价格路径的分叉。
AI.practical_contributions: 为主权债务市场参与者提供了理解国家信誉动态的分析框架，解释了为何债务价格可能不完全反映当前债务比率，以及为何国家在危机时期通过债务削减（而非及时偿还）来建立信誉。

title: Assessing the Empirical Evidence for Loss of Control from Agentic General-Purpose AI
affiliations: Future of Life Institute, Future of Life Institute, Cambridge, Future of Life Institute,  and RAND Corporation

detail.title: Assessing the Empirical Evidence for Loss of Control from Agentic General-Purpose AI
detail.abstract: Theoretical literature warns that advanced generalist agentic systems might pursue instrumental goals that are misaligned with human preferences, thus posing risks of irreversible loss of human control. The EU's Code of Practice for General-Purpose AI lists loss of control as a systemic risk that must be assessed, yet no systematic evaluation of the empirical evidence for this risk exists. This study fills that gap. We evaluate 19 recent empirical studies across eight properties identified from threat models (such as strategic deception, situational awareness, and autonomous replication), assessing the quality of evidence across three dimensions: construct validity, content validity, and external validity. Our central finding is that the current body of evidence supports a judgment of loss of control as "weakly plausible." In our framework, 'plausibility' denotes the strength and direction of available evidence, not a probability estimate. Emerging evidence exists across multiple properties, but no study achieves validity thresholds required for a stronger judgment. Validity gaps, particularly in external validity, are widespread. Therefore, our findings highlight the need for more rigorous evaluations of agentic general-purpose AI systems. However, for the most dangerous properties, high external validity may be structurally unachievable under responsible research practices, reflecting a ceiling on feasible evidence rather than absence of the capability. Furthermore, as AI capabilities advance rapidly, empirical assessments may systematically lag behind the capability frontier. Our framework provides a structured baseline for ongoing monitoring as capabilities advance.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了19项关于通用智能体系统失控风险的实证研究，发现现有证据支持"弱可信"的判断，指出效度缺口普遍存在，且对最危险属性的高外部效度评估在负责任研究实践中可能结构性地不可实现。
AI.research_question: 通用智能体系统失控风险的实证证据如何？现有证据是否支持将其判定为系统性风险？
AI.motivation: 欧盟《通用人工智能行为准则》将失控列为必须评估的系统性风险，但缺乏系统的实证证据评估。理论文献警告失控风险，但尚无研究系统梳理和评估现有实证证据的质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于威胁模型识别的八个属性（如策略性欺骗、情境感知、自主复制），以及构建效度、内容效度、外部效度三个评估维度。
AI.method: 系统评估19项近期实证研究，从构建效度、内容效度和外部效度三个维度分析证据质量。
AI.findings: 现有证据支持失控为"弱可信"判断；多个属性存在初步证据，但无研究达到更强判断所需的效度阈值；外部效度缺口普遍存在；对于最危险属性，高外部效度在负责任研究实践中可能结构性地无法实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了评估通用智能体失控风险的标准化框架，明确了"可信性"作为证据强度与方向而非概率估计的概念界定，揭示了实证评估能力滞后于AI能力前沿的系统性局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟等监管机构评估失控风险提供了结构化基线；指出需要更严格的智能体通用AI系统评估；提醒政策制定者注意最危险属性的证据获取存在结构性天花板。

title: The Effect of Inventory Management on a Firm’s Profit (A Study of Amo Byng Nigeria Limited, Aba Branch, Abia State)

detail.title: The Effect of Inventory Management on a Firm’s Profit (A Study of Amo Byng Nigeria Limited, Aba Branch, Abia State)
detail.abstract: The study examined the effect of inventory management and control on the profit and productivity of manufacturing firms in Nigeria using Amo-Byng Nigeria limited, Aba branch as a case study. A descriptive research design was adopted. The primary data were obtained through the administration of questionnaires and oral interviews were equally conducted. The constructed questionnaires were administered to the workers in various departments such as: accounts, production, stores, purchasing, distribution and human resources. The statistical tool used for this work is Chi-square(x2) and the data gotten were carefully analyzed with the aid of simple percentages. Based on the analysis, it was discovered that in Amo Byng Nigeria limited, there is a significant relationship between inventory control and profitability, there is an effect of inventory management on profit and there is a significant relationship between inventory control and productivity. It is therefore recommended that the firm should adhere to existing policies concerning inventories which will help them to know what amount of inventory to order at a particular time, when should an order be placed and how much safety stock should be kept. It should ensure that the management and control of inventories is effective and efficient through regular training of its workers in the inventory unit, efforts should be geared towards buying quality materials to avert an incessant breakdown of machines which may result to stoppage in production.

AI.tldr: 本研究以Amo-Byng Nigeria Limited为案例，采用描述性研究设计和卡方检验，发现尼日利亚制造企业的库存管理与控制对盈利能力和生产率有显著正向影响，并提出了加强库存政策执行、员工培训和采购高质量材料等建议。
AI.research_question: 库存管理与控制对尼日利亚制造企业利润和生产率的影响如何？
AI.motivation: 库存管理对制造企业运营至关重要，但尼日利亚制造企业在库存控制方面面临挑战，研究旨在探索其对企业利润和生产率的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 库存管理理论、库存控制与盈利能力关系理论、库存控制与生产率关系理论
AI.method: 描述性研究设计，通过问卷和口头访谈收集一手数据，运用卡方检验和简单百分比进行统计分析。
AI.findings: 1. 库存控制与盈利能力存在显著关系；2. 库存管理对利润有显著影响；3. 库存控制与生产率存在显著关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了库存管理理论在尼日利亚制造企业情境下的适用性，丰富了发展中国家的库存管理实证研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议企业严格执行库存政策以优化订购批量、订购时点及安全库存水平；加强库存部门员工培训；采购高质量材料以减少机器故障造成的生产中断。

title: Are Natural Catastrophes and Social Shocks Usable Triggers for Economic Cat Bonds? A Machine Learning Assessment
affiliations: and Universidad Europea de Madrid

detail.title: Are Natural Catastrophes and Social Shocks Usable Triggers for Economic Cat Bonds? A Machine Learning Assessment
detail.abstract: This study evaluates whether environmental and social variables can serve as effective triggers for economic crisis-linked catastrophe bonds using machine learning techniques. We analyze monthly stock market data from four diverse economies-Spain (IBEX 35), the United States (S&P 500), Brazil (Bovespa), and Japan (Nikkei 225)-spanning 1985-2023 (1993-2023 for Spain and Brazil due to index data availability). Employing both XGBoost (gradient boosting) and LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) neural networks with 5-fold time series cross-validation, we assess regression (return prediction) and classification (crisis detection) tasks. Our findings reveal that environmental variables (temperature, precipitation, CO 2 emissions) and social indicators (disaster-affected population) consistently rank among the least important predictors across all countries, with average SHAP importance ranks of 12-17 out of 17 features. Market-derived volatility measures and traditional macroeconomic variables dominate feature importance in both model architectures. While regression models show limited predictive power (XGBoost average R 2 :-0.17; LSTM average R 2 :-0.18), classification models achieve promising results for crisis detection, with AUC values between 0.82 and 0.91. These results suggest that economic CAT bonds would be better served by volatility-based or macroeconomic triggers rather than environmental or social indicators measured at national aggregate levels.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用机器学习（XGBoost和LSTM）评估环境与社会变量能否作为经济危机巨灾债券的触发因素。分析西班牙、美国、巴西和日本四国股市数据（1985-2023年）发现，环境和社会变量在预测危机中重要性最低（排名12-17/17），市场波动性和宏观变量更为关键。分类模型在危机检测中表现良好（AUC 0.82-0.91），而回归预测效果较差。
AI.research_question: 环境与社会变量能否作为经济危机关联巨灾债券（catastrophe bonds）的有效触发因素？
AI.motivation: 传统巨灾债券多基于自然灾害事件触发，但经济危机同样需要新型风险转移工具。现有研究缺乏对环境和社会变量在经济危机预测及巨灾债券设计中的作用探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习预测理论（XGBoost梯度提升、LSTM长短期记忆神经网络）、SHAP特征重要性分析、时间序列交叉验证。
AI.method: 收集西班牙（IBEX 35）、美国（S&P 500）、巴西（Bovespa）和日本（Nikkei 225）四国1985-2023年（部分国家1993-2023年）月度股市数据，使用XGBoost和LSTM两种模型，结合5折时间序列交叉验证，分别进行回归（收益率预测）和分类（危机检测）任务，采用SHAP值衡量特征重要性。
AI.findings: 1. 环境和社会变量在所有国家中均为最不重要的预测因子（SHAP重要性排名12-17/17）；2. 市场波动性指标和传统宏观经济变量主导特征重要性；3. 回归模型预测能力有限（XGBoost R²=-0.17, LSTM R²=-0.18）；4. 分类模型在危机检测中表现良好（AUC 0.82-0.91）。
AI.theory_contributions: 否定了环境和社会变量作为经济危机巨灾债券触发因素的有效性，支持基于市场波动性和宏观经济指标的触发机制设计。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巨灾债券设计者提供实证依据：经济危机CAT债券应优先采用波动性指标或宏观经济变量作为触发条件，而非环境或社会指标。

title: Severity - A Proposed Disclosure Metric for the Gap Between Modeled and Realized Tail Risk in Regulated Institutions

detail.title: Severity - A Proposed Disclosure Metric for the Gap Between Modeled and Realized Tail Risk in Regulated Institutions
detail.abstract:
Across more than two decades of correlated stress events involving multi-strategy hedge funds, statistical-arbitrage portfolios, volatility-targeting mandates, and liability-driven hedging programs, a consistent feature has been the divergence between model-based tail-risk estimates and realized losses during the stress window itself. In the author’s view, what successive episodes have made visible as position crowding is more accurately understood as the surface expression of a deeper convergence in signal calibration, hedging frameworks, and liquidity management across the broader multi-strategy ecosystem — a convergence that has grown larger and less directly observable as the underlying frameworks have become more sophisticated and more uniformly adopted.

The Basel market-risk framework requires institutions employing internal models to compute and archive daily Value-at-Risk predictions — and, under the Fundamental Review of the Trading Book, Expected Shortfall predictions — alongside realized profit-and-loss outcomes. This archive, maintained continuously since the 1996 Market Risk Amendment, contains a complete institutional record of the gap between what model-based tail-risk estimates predicted and what realized market conditions delivered. The historical content of this archive is, in effect, the empirical record of the convergence described above. It has been used for supervisory backtesting and capital adjustment but has not been organized into a publicly comparable disclosure of model performance under stress.

This paper proposes a supplementary disclosure metric, termed Severity, computed directly from the existing backtesting archive. Severity is defined as the divergence between predicted tail loss and realized loss during stress windows, reported in two complementary forms: an average form over a defined stress sample, and a top-N form analogous to maximum-drawdown reporting in fund performance disclosure. The proposal requires no new data collection, no new computational infrastructure, and no methodological commitment regarding any replacement framework. It re-purposes existing supervisory data into a comparable, auditable, third-party-reproducible disclosure that allocators, regulators, counterparties, and risk-committee members could use to size exposures with explicit visibility into the historical limitations of the frameworks governing institutional leverage.

The paper situates the proposal within the existing Basel and U.S. regulatory architecture, discusses the supervisory discretion that currently mutes the regulatory expression of the historical record while preserving the underlying data, defines the metric formally in both average and top-N forms, specifies stress-sample conventions, presents an empirical motivation drawn from the recurring pattern of correlated stress events across the past four decades, addresses anticipated implementation objections including those that arise from model substitution and disclosure gaming, and discusses limitations and open questions for further empirical work.

title: Hold-Out: The Injustice of Delaying Justice
affiliations: Ericsson

detail.title: Hold-Out: The Injustice of Delaying Justice

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed by Ericsson, which operates in the sector addressed in this paper. No separate remuneration or compensation was received for the research, writing, or publication of this work.

detail.abstract: This article examines the role of hold-out in standard essential patent (SEP) licensing negotiations and its implications for fair, reasonable, and non-discriminatory (FRAND) licensing. It argues that hold-out is not merely a theoretical concern but a recurring market practice through which implementers delay or resist taking SEP licenses to obtain commercial leverage and reduce royalty payments. The article analyzes how the availability of injunctive relief influences negotiation incentives and explains why arbitration, despite offering a neutral and efficient mechanism to resolve FRAND disputes, is often rejected by unwilling licensees unless injunctions are a realistic possibility. Using the recent Transsion dispute as a case study, the article illustrates how procedural delays and litigation strategies may be used to postpone the conclusion of a license agreement even where FRAND-compliant offers have been made. The article concludes that the availability of injunctions remains critical to discouraging holdout, promoting timely dispute resolution, and preserving incentives for continued participation in standards-based innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨标准必要专利（SEP）许可谈判中的“hold-out”（拖延许可）行为，论证其并非理论风险而是现实的市场实践。研究表明，禁令救济的可得性对遏制hold-out至关重要，而仲裁机制在缺乏禁令威胁时往往被不愿付费的实施者拒绝。通过传音（Transsion）案例，文章揭示了程序性拖延和诉讼策略如何被用于推迟许可协议的达成。
AI.research_question: 标准必要专利许可谈判中，hold-out（拖延许可）行为的现实存在性及其对FRAND许可机制的影响如何？禁令救济在遏制hold-out和促进及时解决FRAND纠纷中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注专利劫持（patent hold-up），而对hold-out（实施者拖延许可）的研究相对不足。本文试图纠正这一失衡，强调hold-out是实际存在的市场实践，并论证禁令救济在维持FRAND生态平衡中的关键作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于谈判理论、FRAND承诺的法律经济学分析、以及禁令救济与谈判激励之间的相互作用机制。
AI.method: 规范分析结合案例研究。通过对传音（Transsion）SEP争议的实证分析，揭示hold-out的实际运作机制。
AI.findings: 1. Hold-out是反复出现的市场实践，而非理论假设。2. 禁令救济的可得性是促使不愿付费的实施者诚信谈判的关键激励因素。3. 仲裁作为替代性纠纷解决机制，在没有禁令威胁时往往被抵制。4. 程序性策略（如管辖权挑战、延期动议）可被用于系统性拖延许可谈判。5. 弱化禁令救济会削弱标准参与者的创新激励。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了FRAND许可领域的理论框架，弥补了学界对hold-out行为系统性分析的不足，为理解禁令救济与谈判激励之间的关系提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和法院提供了关于FRAND许可机制改革的实证依据和实践建议，特别是关于如何平衡专利劫持与hold-out双重风险的制度设计。

title: An Oligopoly Analysis of the Telecommunications Industry in Oman: Market Structure, Competition, and Consumer Demand
affiliations: Sultan Qaboos University and Sultan Qaboos University

detail.title: An Oligopoly Analysis of the Telecommunications Industry in Oman: Market Structure, Competition, and Consumer Demand
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the telecommunications industry in Oman through the lens of oligopoly theory, examining market structure, firm behavior, consumer demand, and policy implications. Using secondary data from Omantel, Ooredoo Oman, and Vodafone Oman, alongside reports from the Telecommunications Regulatory Authority and international organizations, the study applies concentration ratios, Bertrand and Cournot oligopoly models, and elasticity analysis. The calculated CR3 ratio of 100% confirms a highly concentrated oligopoly characterized by significant barriers to entry and strong strategic interdependence among dominant firms. Demand is found to be relatively price inelastic for essential telecommunications services, while premium service segments exhibit greater income elasticity among higher-income consumers. Competition is driven primarily by service differentiation, network quality, and technological innovation rather than price alone. The study recommends policies including infrastructure sharing, promotion of Mobile Virtual Network Operators (MVNOs), and targeted price regulation for essential services to improve market efficiency, consumer welfare, and digital inclusion in Oman.

AI.tldr: 本文运用寡头垄断理论分析阿曼电信行业，发现该市场由三家运营商高度集中（CR3=100%），需求缺乏价格弹性，竞争主要来自服务差异化和技术创新，并提出了基础设施共享、促进MVNO等政策建议。
AI.research_question: 阿曼电信行业的市场结构、企业行为、消费者需求及政策含义是什么？
AI.motivation: 电信行业对阿曼经济和社会发展至关重要，但该市场高度集中，需要系统分析其寡头垄断特征及对消费者福利和数字包容性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 寡头垄断理论，包括贝特朗竞争模型、古诺竞争模型、集中度比率（CR3）、需求弹性分析（价格弹性与收入弹性）。
AI.method: 使用Omantel、Ooredoo Oman和Vodafone Oman的二手数据，结合电信监管局和国际组织的报告，进行集中度计算、寡头模型分析及弹性分析。
AI.findings: （1）CR3比率为100%，市场高度集中，进入壁垒显著，现有企业间战略相互依赖性强；（2）基础电信服务需求相对缺乏价格弹性，高端服务需求在高收入群体中收入弹性较大；（3）竞争主要来自服务差异化、网络质量和技术创新，而非单纯的价格竞争。
AI.theory_contributions: 将寡头垄断理论应用于阿曼电信行业的实证分析，验证了贝特朗和古诺模型在解释该市场企业行为中的适用性，丰富了发展中经济体电信市场结构的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出基础设施共享、促进移动虚拟网络运营商（MVNO）发展、对基础服务实施针对性价格监管等政策建议，以提升市场效率、消费者福利和阿曼的数字包容性。

reference: Center for Governance and Markets Paper No. DA5-2026
title: Reimagining the Delivery of Development Assistance with Blockchain
affiliations: Stellar Development Foundation

detail.title: Reimagining the Delivery of Development Assistance with Blockchain

publicationDetails.detailsText: Center for Governance and Markets Paper No. DA5-2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Center for Governance & Markets Paper Series

detail.abstract: Development assistance is entering a period of significant constraint. Recent funding cuts require development organizations to achieve greater impact with fewer resources, making it essential to modernize the financial infrastructure used to move, safeguard, and account for funds. When deployed effectively, blockchain-based systems can deliver material improvements over legacy ones-reducing friction and opacity in cross-border payments; enhancing financial and operational risk management; enabling real-time transparency, traceability, and auditability of funds; and supporting innovative finance. In doing so, blockchain can help development organizations deliver more with limited resources.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文讨论了在开发援助资金缩减的背景下，如何通过区块链技术现代化金融基础设施，以提高资金流动效率、透明度、风险管理能力，从而帮助开发组织用更少的资源实现更大的影响力。
AI.research_question: 区块链技术如何帮助开发组织在资源受限的条件下，通过现代化金融基础设施来实现更大的影响力？
AI.motivation: 开发援助进入资金大幅削减的时期，组织需要以更少资源实现更大影响，因此亟需升级资金转移、保管和核算的金融基础设施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区块链技术应用于开发金融的理论基础，涵盖去中心化账本、智能合约、跨境支付、透明审计、风险管理等。
AI.method: 概念分析与案例论证，基于区块链在跨境支付、风险管理、透明审计及创新金融等方面的应用逻辑。
AI.findings: 区块链系统能有效减少跨境支付的摩擦和不透明性，增强财务与运营风险管理，实现资金的实时透明、可追溯和可审计，并支持创新金融。
AI.theory_contributions: 为区块链在开发金融领域的应用提供了系统性分析框架，拓展了区块链技术在非营利和公共部门的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开发组织在资源约束下采用区块链技术优化金融基础设施提供了实践路径，帮助实现"事半功倍"的效果。

reference: WU International Taxation Research Paper Series No. 2026-04
title: Survive, Heal or Die? Zombie Firms and Tax Planning
affiliations: WU Vienna University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Survive, Heal or Die? Zombie Firms and Tax Planning

publicationDetails.detailsText: WU International Taxation Research Paper Series No. 2026-04
publicationDetails.journalName: WU International Taxation Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Zombie firms are firms that continue to operate despite prolonged periods of financial distress. When part of a group, such firms may serve as tax planning instruments by facilitating profit shifting or loss offsets. This paper studies the role of zombie firms in group-level tax planning by examining their response to DAC6, an EU directive mandating the disclosure of aggressive tax planning arrangements. Using firm-level data from ORBIS and a differences-indifferences design, I find that following DAC6, group zombie firms in the EU are more likely to exit the market than their non-EU counterparts. Among surviving firms, the probability of remaining a zombie declines for EU group firms. Heterogeneity analyses show that both firm location and group headquarters location shape these responses, highlighting how zombie firms are used within groups for tax planning purposes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究僵尸企业（长期财务困境但仍存续的企业）在企业集团税务筹划中的作用。利用欧盟DAC6指令（要求披露激进税务筹划安排）作为外生冲击，基于ORBIS数据和双重差分法，发现该指令实施后，欧盟集团中的僵尸企业比非欧盟同行更可能退出市场；存续的欧盟集团僵尸企业"僵尸化"概率也下降。异质性分析表明，企业所在地和集团总部所在地均影响这一反应，揭示了集团利用僵尸企业进行税务筹划的机制。
AI.research_question: 企业集团是否利用僵尸企业作为税务筹划工具？欧盟DAC6指令（强制披露激进税务筹划安排）如何影响集团僵尸企业的存续与退出决策？
AI.motivation: 僵尸企业通常被视为资源错配和经济效率低下的来源，但鲜有研究探讨其在集团内部可能的"正面"作用——即作为利润转移或亏损抵免的税务筹划工具。本研究从税务筹划角度重新审视僵尸企业的功能，为理解集团内部资本配置和避税行为提供新视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税务筹划理论（利润转移、亏损抵免）、企业集团内部资本市场理论、制度经济学（监管披露对行为的影响）
AI.method: 双重差分法（DID），利用ORBIS企业层面数据，比较欧盟与非欧盟集团僵尸企业在DAC6实施前后的退出概率和"僵尸状态"变化。包含异质性分析（企业所在地、集团总部所在地）。
AI.findings: （1）DAC6实施后，欧盟集团僵尸企业比非欧盟同行更可能退出市场；（2）存续的欧盟集团僵尸企业，"僵尸化"概率下降；（3）异质性分析显示，企业所在地和集团总部所在地共同影响上述反应，表明集团确实利用僵尸企业进行税务筹划。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次从税务筹划角度解释僵尸企业的存在价值，挑战了"僵尸企业纯属资源浪费"的传统认知；（2）将税务筹划研究从正常经营企业拓展至财务困境企业，丰富了企业避税行为的边界；（3）揭示了披露监管（DAC6）如何通过提高税务筹划成本，间接影响僵尸企业的退出决策。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者提供证据：加强税务筹划披露（如DAC6）可促使集团清算僵尸企业，减少资源错配；（2）提示税务机关关注集团内部僵尸企业的税务功能，完善反避税监管；（3）对企业管理者而言，需重新评估集团内僵尸企业的隐性成本与收益，尤其在税务合规趋严背景下。
